description: A Gray-code counter. Module `gray4` with inputs clk, rst_n (active-low reset) and en, and a 4-bit output gray. At each rising clock edge where en is 1 it moves to the next value of the 4-bit reflected binary Gray code (0, 1, 3, 2, 6, 7, 5, 4, 12, 13, 15, 14, 10, 11, 9, 8, then back to 0). With en 0 it holds. Reset sets it to 0.
